node.statement: Dependency audit addressing ch-401284aa9b26d8b0: the blockwise calculation in node 1.4.2.1 is only conditional and cannot presently establish the amplified identity. Validated nodes 1.2.1 and 1.4.1 supply, respectively, Z_{ji}^dagger in S_{R,P} and the block-adjoint formula, but the equality Ha^Q_{R,P}(Z_{ji}^dagger)=Ha^Q_{P,R}(Z_{ji})^dagger is exactly node 1.3, whose epistemic state remains pending. It also cannot be reproved from the currently allowed validated external alone: lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities gives adjointness for Co, whereas the derivation of node 1.3 requires (a dot b)^dagger=b^dagger dot a^dagger; converting the Co identity into that formula requires the unregistered definition a dot b:=Co_{A,C}(ab), which neither def-ha-map nor def-hcb-datum nor any registered af definition supplies. Therefore this node must remain pending. The mathematical repair is to provision and register the compressed-product definition, validate the resulting product-reversal step and node 1.3, and only then apply the already-recorded blockwise argument.
